chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou leave C2's residence after Gu Suizhou recovers from a manic state triggered by his differentiation. It is revealed that Shen Feizhi previously acted as a mentor/guide for Gu Suizhou during his differentiation on a deserted island years ago. Shen Feizhi denies being responsible for the pheromone-blocking drugs injected into Gu Suizhou in the past. Gu Suizhou, displaying a clingy and manipulative personality, follows Shen Feizhi to his own apartment, which has been kept exactly as it was before Shen Feizhi disappeared four years ago.
